summary: Tiny forecourt of a commercial building in a dense apartment area.
reasons: Apartments 18 m away, homes all round
Loading and no-stopping signs on frontage

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by apartment blocks 18 to 26 m away and busy commercial frontage.
drivers.access_and_room: Small hard-standing strip against a building with no vehicles or tracks visible; looks like a private forecourt.
drivers.traffic: Inner-city street with traffic, pedestrians and nearby businesses.
drivers.convention: Signs show loading zone and no stopping at specified times; no sign of overnight parking.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.5 m elevation, 253 m from Brisbane River
Loading zone and no-stopping signs on adjacent kerb
Apartments Aura and Arriva 18 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open, shaded by the building to the east in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the forecourt is private or gated

best_section.where: Strip beside The Nest Creative Space on the corner of Brisbane Street
